svg.text: km::write_pages(writer, command, state, page, 1, scratch) && writes_done()
On one island each call is the local page read or write. Over islands a core reads the pages its island holds from its own DRAM;
each run of pages another island holds is one line across, an ask or a put, waited for at the core's port. The kernel is the same.
a tensor is placed by a hint, and a kernel names the tensor, never the island
what crosses a link, each measured on two P150A joined by four links
a group over both islands runs as a part on each; the parts are joined into one completion
7.46 µs a command split by the host, 10.89 µs sent across by a thread's dispatcher (25_islands_threads)
messages.forward to a rank of the other island as to any rank, many messages to a packet
4.7 µs a crossing in a run of round trips; about 4.7 million 64-byte messages a second each way (05_forward)
a reduce's part, a broadcast's block
each island folds, or casts, inside itself; one part an island crosses
a sum over 238 ranks 172.6 µs against 162.8 on one island of 119 (02_merge_tree, kernels unchanged)
km::read_pages, km::write_pages, km::put_pages: each run of pages another island holds is one line
512 MiB: puts 72.5 GB/s each way with both islands putting, reads 40.6 to 48.3 GB/s (experiments/islands_pages)
km::put_bytes, km::read_bytes: bytes of a page another island holds; the rest of the page untouched
65,536 keys placed across in 5.99 ms, 0.091 µs a key (09_bucket_sort); a range read across every 1.70 to 1.95 µs
kmx_fetch, kmx_store of a tensor another island holds, straight between the two DRAMs
64 MiB in 1.13 ms, 59.5 GB/s; the session's own call, session.cross: 512 MiB in 5.35 ms, 100.4 GB/s

svg.text: a reduce or broadcast inside this island
the first rank of each island's part
one part to a rank of island i
the group; its first rank; a local send
a kernel may act by island, in its own words
Ranks are flat and contiguous by island. A core holds a table with one entry for each island, not one for each rank; a link runs through
the router on an Ethernet tile of each card (row 1 of the grid). Every number is a run on two Blackhole P150A joined by four links.
